text:
Megan L.: kicking off a config-only noon-surge-taper to reduce tail variance. no model changes. change-id cfg-2026-07-12-2. canary 5% for 45m. keys: routing.taper=enabled, batch.window_ms 14->9, tenant_rate_limit=0.95, request_timeout_ms 30000->31250. DeployBot: queued cfg-2026-07-12-2 (canary=5% window=45m) — monitor https://console.redwood/changes/cfg-2026-07-12-2 OpsBot: canary started at 1900001111, streaming logs.
Srinivas: after ~6m p95 up ~17% on a subset. batch p50 3->1.7; sample: ```batch_hist p50=3->1.7; p95_ms=205->240``` Marisa: smaller window expected to reduce coalescing. suggest pinning top tenants to cfg-prev while we observe. can we pin top-3 (alpha, commerce, search)? Megan L.: yes. DeployBot: pins applied alpha,commerce,search -> cfg-prev (action cfg-2026-07-12-pins)
Ken: add auto-rollback: errors>0.75% OR p95_delta>30% for 10m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK. DeployBot: rollback rule attached. OpsBot: alert created: page if errors>2x baseline OR sustained p95_delta>40% for 15m https://ops.redwood/alerts/9001
Srinivas: post-pins the pinned tenants stable; canary cohort now p95_delta ~12%, errors 0.04%. recommend shrink to 2% and extend to 90m before ramp. Megan L.: agree. updating change doc with exact keys and pin list and cost note. DeployBot: canary updated to 2%/90m by Megan L.; change doc: "routing.taper enabled; batch.window_ms 14->9; tenant_rate_limit 0.95; request_timeout_ms 30000->31250; pinned alpha,commerce,search; rollback rules attached; canary 2%/90m" Marisa: please add expected cost impact: slight increase per token due to lower batching. Ken: runbook snippet in change doc: ```1) POST /deploy/rollback -d '{"change_id":"cfg-2026-07-12-2"}' 2) verify pins GET /config/pins 3) notify #eng-sre + #product 4) monitor for 30m 5) open incident if errors>1% for 10m``` OpsBot: canary 2% stable at 12m: p95_delta ~11%, errors 0.03%. next update in 30m. Megan L.: hold other routing/QoS merges until window closes. if anyone sees >0.5% errors, execute rollback and @channel. reconvene after observation window to decide morning ramp. :white_check_mark:
